ownership.summary: MOVA is presented by Dreame as a member of the Dreame family and uses shared group technology, supply-chain, digital and channel resources. It should not be treated as a separate listed company. Official materials name Spacewalker Technology entities for the brand, MOVAhome app and regional websites, while robotic-mower declarations name Kutting Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. These related roles do not make one entity the universal manufacturer or seller for every MOVA category.

productPortfolio.name: Robot vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: A broad range from value-oriented models to premium roller-mop and highly automated dock platforms.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports multiple price tiers but requires exact model checks for navigation, mopping, obstacle handling, consumables and regional service.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-and-dry and cordless vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Manual floorcare extends MOVA beyond autonomous cleaning into sensor-led wet cleaning and dry vacuuming.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds floorcare breadth while creating separate battery, roller, detergent and parts requirements.

productPortfolio.name: Robotic lawn mowers and garden tools
productPortfolio.positioning: LiDAR- and vision-led wire-free mowers sit beside powered garden equipment in MOVA's outdoor ecosystem.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires site survey, terrain, navigation, dealer installation, seasonal storage and local repair checks.

productPortfolio.name: Pool, window and adjacent smart-living products
productPortfolio.positioning: Pool cleaners, window robots, pet care, personal care and small appliances expand MOVA into a wide smart-living portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates cross-category opportunity but demands category-specific compliance and after-sales planning.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Official MOVA mower declarations place Kutting Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. in manufacturer and compliance roles for named mower types.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the declaration, manufacturer and factory information to the exact mower model and market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Spacewalker Technology companies appear in MOVA brand, app, privacy and regional site records.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not infer physical factory origin from an app developer, privacy issuer or ecommerce operator.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dreame and MOVA share visible technology, supply-chain and channel infrastructure, but product records remain category- and model-specific.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the actual legal manufacturer, assembly site, exporter and quality owner for each contracted SKU.

marketsChannels.evidence: MOVA operates global and country websites with regional Spacewalker entities or authorized distributors named in terms and legal disclosures.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the site operator, merchant of record, importer and warranty provider for the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: MOVA products are also sold through marketplaces, retailers and local distributors with market-specific assortments.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm authorization, model suffix, app region, parts access and written warranty terms.

marketsChannels.evidence: The UK legal disclosure states that Beam Group operates the store as authorized distributor, seller and merchant of record without claiming the MOVA trademark.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not generalize the UK merchant structure to other countries.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: MOVA uses Dreame Group's engineering and international infrastructure to expand unusually quickly across indoor cleaning, lawn, pool and adjacent smart-living categories. That breadth creates distributor opportunity and strong launch velocity. The principal buyer risk is operating complexity: MOVA, Dreame, Spacewalker, Kutting and local distributors can each appear in different records, so category excitement must be matched with exact responsibility mapping and dependable regional service.
